long:
Originally from South Africa, I founded Nature Me New and Cancel Cancer in 2018, providing integrative health coaching, metabolic oncology education, nutrigenomics, functional health insights, and personalized patient advocacy.

My practice supports individuals navigating cancer, autoimmune conditions, chronic illness, metabolic dysfunction, and general wellness concerns. I combine scientific research, lifestyle coaching, and personalized education to help clients better understand their biology and make informed, sustainable health decisions. I particularly enjoy translating complex science into relatable explanations using imagery and analogies.

Now based in Jacksonville, Florida, I continue offering virtual consultations and health education internationally. I am transitioning my South African businesses into two new U.S.-focused platforms: OncoSyence, specializing in cancer science, metabolic oncology education, and patient advocacy, and Syence One, focusing on integrative wellness, metabolic health, and personalized coaching.

My philosophy is grounded in hope, compassion, scientific curiosity, and empowering individuals to take an active role in their health.
